title: Proxies
description: Outbound proxy pool of namespace {{namespace}}: health, per-site state and manual operations
noNamespace: Select a namespace to manage its proxies.

operationDescriptions.disable: Disabled proxies are not used for new leases until they are enabled again.
operationDescriptions.enable: Enabled proxies return to the active pool.
operationDescriptions.ban: Banned proxies are not used until the ban ends or they are unbanned.
operationDescriptions.unban: Lifts the ban; the proxies return to the active pool.
operationDescriptions.cooldown: Cooling proxies are skipped by the scheduler until the cooldown ends, on one site or on all sites.
operationDescriptions.quarantine: Quarantined proxies are skipped until the quarantine ends or is released.
operationDescriptions.unquarantine: Releases the quarantine; the proxies return to the active pool.
operationDescriptions.archive: Archived proxies are retired: they are never used and are hidden unless you filter for retired proxies. Restore brings them back.
operationDescriptions.restore: Restores retired proxies to the active pool.
operationDescriptions.reset_stats: Resets health scores and failure counters, on one site or on all sites.

operate.siteHint: Limit the operation to one site, or apply it to all sites.
operate.siteNamePlaceholder: Site name; empty applies to all sites
operate.durationOptionalHint: Leave empty to use the action policy default.
operate.durationPermanentHint: Use "permanent" for a ban without an end.
operate.permanentWarning: A permanent ban never ends by itself; the proxies stay banned until someone unbans them.
operate.reasonPlaceholder: Recorded in state events and the audit log

errors.duration_zero: The duration must be greater than zero.

delete.description: Deleting removes the proxies and their identity bindings permanently. This cannot be undone; archive proxies instead to keep their history.
delete.boundWarning_one: {{count}} identity is bound to these proxies and will lose its binding.
delete.boundWarning_other: {{count}} identities are bound to these proxies and will lose their binding.

filters.search: Search URL, host, exit IP or ID…
filters.regionsPlaceholder: Add a region and press Enter
filters.tagsHint: Proxies must have all of these tags.
filters.tagsPlaceholder: Add a tag and press Enter

empty.title: No proxies yet
empty.description: Import proxies to build the pool. Without a state filter, retired proxies are hidden.

detail.title: Proxy
detail.description: Live health and per-site state; refreshes every 5 seconds.
detail.sitesEmpty: No site has hot state for this proxy yet.

edit.title: Edit proxy
edit.replaceUrlHint: The stored URL and credentials are encrypted and never shown. To change them, enter the complete new URL twice.
edit.confirmUrlDescription: {{name}} will use the new URL and credentials for new leases. Nodes receive the new URL version; leases in flight keep the old one.

url.too_long: The URL must be at most {{max}} bytes.
url.scheme: The URL must start with http://, https:// or socks5://.
url.format: Use scheme://[user[:password]@]host:port without a path, query or fragment.
url.port: The URL must include a port between 1 and 65535.

errors.maxConcurrency: Enter a whole number between 1 and {{max}}.

sessionTemplate.label: Session template
sessionTemplate.help: Tunnel proxies: the user name is rendered from this template for every lease. Click a placeholder to insert it.

placeholders.username: User name from the proxy URL
placeholders.identity_hash: 12 hex characters derived from the identity ID (stable per identity)

import.title: Import proxies
import.description: Proxies are deduplicated by URL; existing proxies receive changed attributes. Run a dry run first.

formatHelp.lines: One URL per line, optionally followed by key=value pairs (kind, region, city, provider, tags=a,b, max_concurrency). Lines starting with # are ignored.
formatHelp.jsonl: One JSON object per line with url, kind, region, city, provider, tags (array), max_concurrency and session_template.
formatHelp.csv: Header row with url and optional kind, region, city, provider, tags (separated by ;), max_concurrency and session_template columns.

import.fileReadFailed: The file could not be read.
import.credentialsNote: Credentials are stored encrypted. Rejected rows are reported by line number without echoing their content.
import.defaults: Defaults for rows that do not set a value
import.dryRunFirst: Run a dry run with the current inputs before importing.
import.dryRunDone: Dry run: {{created}} new, {{updated}} changed, {{unchanged}} unchanged, {{failed}} rejected

errors.data_required: Paste data or choose a file.
